skins.name: Ghost Protocol
skins.description: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted with red paint in varying sheens.\n\nI don't care if you were followed, you're here now - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

skins.name: Code Red
skins.description: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. A custom paint job with a bright red base and white detailing has been applied.\n\nMan your stations

skins.name: Re-Entry
skins.description: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. The barrel has been given a flame decal.\n\nI hate being right all the time - Carmen Cocinero, Extraction Expert

skins.name: Muertos
skins.description: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been custom painted with circular motifs.\n\nThis one is steeped in tradition and blood

skins.name: Neon Rider
skins.description: Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted with the image of a deadly biker.\n\nOne part firearm, two parts Trapper Keeper

skins.name: Connexion
skins.description: A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. Phoenix faction logos have been spray painted over its white and red base.\n\nThey're bringing in the big guns

skins.name: Bloodsport
skins.description: Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been covered in white logo decals over a red and black hydrographic.\n\nCo-driver wanted

skins.name: Bloodshot
skins.description: The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been custom painted with a monstrosity comprised of green tentacles, teeth, and one eyeball.\n\nAll the better to see you with

skins.name: Desert Hydra
skins.description: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. Gold snakes creep towards the barrel of this custom painted AWP. The scope, barrel, and butt stock have been painted white.\n\nCutting off one head means two more appear—is that a risk you're willing to take? - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

skins.name: Trapper Aggressor | Guerrilla Warfare
skins.description: The experienced and cunning Trapper Aggressors utilize ruthless efficiency in capturing and securing tourists as hostages. As experts in wetland and jungle-based guerrilla tactics, any rescue missions involving Trapper Aggressors are doomed to fail. \n\nThe promise of air conditioning and iced tea. It works every time.

skins.name: Slaughter
skins.description: This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.\n\nValeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

skins.name: Slingshot
skins.description: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching.

skins.name: Hydra
skins.description: Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. A custom paint job referencing Operation Hydra, CS:GO's 8th Operation, has been applied.\n\nWorth the wait

skins.name: Bad Trip
skins.description: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been custom painted with brightly colored monsters.\n\nWhen you've had too much

skins.name: Full Throttle
skins.description: More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with a neon green base and finished with fictitious logos meant to evoke drift and tuning culture.\n\nWhere \"Globoil 1 Synthetics\" meets \"ENTRI PERFORMANCE\"

skins.name: Monster Mashup
skins.description: A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. A custom paint job featuring a green monster and other icons inspired by popular urban art has been applied. The silencer has a pearlescent finish.\n\nX__X

skins.name: Emerald Jörmungandr
skins.description: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. A green pattern depicting Jörmungandr, the World Serpent, has been applied.\n\nWake the gods

skins.name: Fatal Glitch
skins.description: With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been custom painted using bright green pearlescent paint.\n\nWhen keeping a low profile isn't an option

skins.name: Containment Breach
skins.description: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted to depict mutated rats trying to escape a radioactive, neon green forest.\n\nWho knows what radioactive diseases they carry…

skins.name: Abyssal Apparition
skins.description: Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. This custom paint job depicts abandoned souls falling into a pit of nightmares.\n\nYou cannot escape your destiny

skins.name: Lt. Commander Ricksaw | NSWC SEAL
skins.description: Lt. Commander Ricksaw's comically laissez-faire attitude toward heavy combat keeps his SEAL team calm and deadly in the most dire situations. Having lead more special ops than any other SEAL to date, Ricksaw knows life is short, and encourages his team to make the most of the time they have—including cheerfully serving up bullets and frag grenades to high- value targets at any and all occasions. Hotdogs, hellcats and hand grenades. Hooya!

skins.name: Gamma Doppler
skins.description: This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

skins.name: Hedge Maze
skins.description: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching. The green and white gloves were manufactured by Icarus Athletics.\n\nOnly cowards fear flying close to the sun
